model_note: Devin CLI model UID (GPT-5.5 family, no-thinking variant). The ACP backend has no temperature knob; a no-thinking model is the closest to the issue's 'temperature as low as the API allows'.
prompt_transport: one ACP session/prompt turn; system + '\n\n' + user concatenated into a single text block (backend.acpReply), fresh session per call
system_prompt: You are a technology reviewer writing for engineers. Answer directly, in Markdown.

candidates.why_not: footnotes, a sources table, and horizontal rules put it closer to knap's apparatus-rich output than to the flat pattern

selection.criterion: typical flat pattern (wall paragraph, header, wall paragraph); clean, not broken

notes: Issue #92 asks for Spark and Wonder; MODEL_API_KEY was unavailable, so the output was produced through knap-mcp's acp backend (backend.Kind.acp -> acp.zig -> `devin acp`) per the lane brief.

The brief's example KNAP_ACP_AGENT, `devin acp --agent-type summarizer`, was tried first; the summarizer agent returns a session-summary envelope (<summary>...</summary>) describing the request rather than a document, so the default agent was used.
Output is saved verbatim; no post-edits. A re-render on a sponsor model (Spark/Wonder) can replace it if MODEL_API_KEY lands.
